tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App window and lock-overlay background. Warm sand by day, a dark umber by night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, device rows, permission cards and menus that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks: segmented-control trough, switch track (off), countdown ring track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`. 15:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, helper copy on `surface` and `surface-raised`. 5.6:1 light, 7.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (secondary button, segments, inputs). Meets 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: The brand colour (terracotta clay) and the LOCKED state: primary buttons, hold-to-lock fill, countdown arc, active segment. Text in `seal` reads on `surface` (4.5:1 light, 7.5:1 dark; white on a `seal` fill is 5:1).

tokens.name: seal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for `seal` controls.

tokens.name: seal-edge
tokens.usage: The travel edge under the keycap-style Lock button: a darker clay, so the button reads as a key standing on its side. Decorative only.

tokens.name: on-seal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `seal` or `seal-strong` fill. Dark text in the dark theme because the clay lightens there.

tokens.name: suds
tokens.usage: Tint of `seal`: the locked-overlay wash, swallowed-keycap face, selected device row.

tokens.name: on-suds
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `suds`. 6.3:1 light, 9.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: ARMING and the last 10 seconds of a countdown. Ochre, kept yellow so it never reads as the clay brand colour. Text, ring stroke and pill dot on `surface` / `surface-raised`; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Missing permission, failed lock, force-unlock. A crimson, cooler than the clay so errors stand apart. Text on `surface`; fill for the force-unlock button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: key-face
tokens.usage: Top of a keycap in the key visualiser.

tokens.name: key-edge
tokens.usage: Keycap border and the 2px travel edge under it.

tokens.name: material-label
tokens.usage: Text on a system material (the frosted macOS panel). Translucent like the system's label colour, so it picks up the material's tint.

tokens.name: material-label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and section labels on a system material.

tokens.name: material-fill
tokens.usage: Grouped rows on a system material: one rounded container per group, like System Settings.

tokens.name: material-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Tracks on a system material: segmented control, switch (off), button hover.

tokens.name: material-control
tokens.usage: The selected segment and switch knob on a system material.

tokens.name: material-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between grouped rows on a system material.

tokens.name: glass-back-1
tokens.usage: Glass icons: top of the solid back shape, neutral (umber by day, sand by night).

tokens.name: glass-back-2
tokens.usage: Glass icons: bottom of the solid back shape, neutral.

tokens.name: glass-front-1
tokens.usage: Glass icons: top of the frosted front layer.

tokens.name: glass-front-2
tokens.usage: Glass icons: bottom of the frosted front layer.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Glass icons: the light edge highlight.

tokens.name: glass-clay-1
tokens.usage: Glass icons where something is locked, ready or welcoming: top of the back shape, in clay.

tokens.name: glass-clay-2
tokens.usage: Glass icons in clay: bottom of the back shape.

tokens.name: glass-on-seal-front-1
tokens.usage: Glass icons on a clay fill (the Lock button): top of the frosted front, contrasting with the clay so the icon doesn't melt into it.

tokens.name: glass-on-seal-front-2
tokens.usage: Glass icons on a clay fill: bottom of the frosted front.

tokens.name: glass-danger-1
tokens.usage: Glass icons for a problem (permission off, lock failed): top of the back shape.

tokens.name: glass-danger-2
tokens.usage: Glass icons for a problem: bottom of the back shape.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the page colour. Uses `ink` so it is maximal contrast on every surface in both themes.

families.ui: "Onest Variable", Onest, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Headline of the lock overlay and empty states.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Window title area and panel headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your mouse and trackpad keep working.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Device names, button labels, row titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, segment labels, pill text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels in the settings panel. Always uppercase.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Countdown on the lock overlay; must be readable from arm's length while you wipe.

styles.name: keycap
styles.usage: Legends on keycaps and shortcut chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between keycaps; gap inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner padding (vertical), gap between stacked form items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, row inner padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Lock-overlay content gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Lock-overlay outer padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills' inner dot, shortcut chips.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keycaps, the brand's signature corner. Also segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, device rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, permission cards, the lock card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and switches.

tokens.name: key-rest
tokens.usage: Keycap at rest: a 2px travel edge.

tokens.name: key-down
tokens.usage: Keycap pressed (or swallowed): travel edge removed, cap shifts down 2px.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Only the floating lock card and menus. Panels use borders, not shadows.

timing.note: Safety timings. These are product rules, not decoration: the UI must honour them.

tokens.name: arm-delay
tokens.usage: Countdown between pressing Lock and the keyboard actually locking, so you can lift your hands and cancel.

tokens.name: hold-to-unlock
tokens.usage: How long the pointer must hold the Unlock button. Stops a cloth brushing the trackpad from unlocking.

tokens.name: caution-window
tokens.usage: Final stretch of a timed lock when the countdown turns `caution`.

tokens.name: auto-arm-delay
tokens.usage: Countdown before a lock that Hushboard started itself after noticing cleaning. Shorter than arm-delay because nobody pressed Lock; the island still has Cancel.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and segment changes.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Overlay fade-in and out.
